description: This file implements the proxy and stub classes for the IUnknown interface within the Thunder RPC framework, including method handling, invocation, and registration logic.

classes.name: UnknownStub
classes.description: Stub class handling incoming IPC messages for IUnknown, managing reference counting and interface querying.

classes.name: UnknownProxy
classes.description: Proxy class facilitating IPC communication for IUnknown, including invocation, ID retrieval, and shutdown.

methods.name: UnknownStub::Handle
methods.description: Handles incoming IPC messages based on method index, performing AddRef, Release, or QueryInterface operations.

methods.name: UnknownProxy::Invoke
methods.description: Invokes a remote method via IPC channel, handling timeouts and errors.

methods.name: UnknownProxy::Id
methods.description: Returns the ID of the IPC channel.

methods.name: UnknownProxy::Shutdown
methods.description: Closes the IPC channel to prevent side effects after a timeout or failure.
